shape.text: An inference API key is the prefix sk-or-v1- followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, 73 characters in total. OpenRouter's own secret-formats page for its guardrail states this shape, and the create-key reference example matches it.
A scanner rule for OpenRouter keys matches the same prefix and 64-hexadecimal body.
An inference key body may contain uppercase hexadecimal characters.

unresolved.reason: No source states whether uppercase hexadecimal is accepted; one scanner rule matches case-insensitively and a few use looser classes than hexadecimal.

shape.text: Keys obtained through the OAuth PKCE flow have the same shape as dashboard-issued keys.

unresolved.reason: Recorded in a research note without a cited source in this family's contract.

issuance.text: Inference keys are created in the account settings (free accounts can create one), are shown once at creation, and no earlier or later prefix version has been found.

unresolved.reason: Recorded in a research note without a cited source in this family's contract; no key was issued.

collisions.text: The key hash returned by the API (used in /api/v1/keys/{hash}) is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters with no prefix, the same body shape without sk-or-v1-. A bare 64-hexadecimal string is therefore not a key, and how the hash relates to the key is undocumented.
The label returned by the API is a masked form: sk-or-v1- plus a short head and tail of the key.

unresolved.reason: Recorded in a research note without a cited source in this family's contract.

collisions.text: Management keys start sk-or-mgmt-, sharing the sk-or- stem; they are a separate family.

unresolved.reason: The management key prefix is stated only on Terraform-related pages, and no provider page documents its body.

collisions.text: OpenAI keys (sk-) and Anthropic keys (sk-ant-) are different families that also begin sk-.
